records.review_notes: Sanofi and Kadmon announce a definitive whole-company merger for USD9.50 cash per common share, approximately USD1.9billion equity value. Nasdaq KDMN is the target. The subsidiary merger cancels the outstanding target shares for cash. September7 was signing; the 8-K explicitly records the joint announcement on September8. Date-only public announcement; no intraday timestamp inferred. Agent-reviewed primary evidence, not an independent human audit or present deal-status claim.
